Real-World Algorithm: 2D Euclidean Distance
In game physics, collision detection, robotics, and navigation engines (such as Google Maps and A* pathfinding), computers calculate the exact straight-line distance between two coordinates (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) using the distance formula:

Mathematical Formula:
distance = √(x2 − x1)2 + (y2 − y1)2
